title: November Weather at Our Stops
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Predict November temperature and rainfall at six stops on the route before each climate chart is revealed, then explore each stop's twelve-month climate.

learningObjectives: Interpret monthly temperature and rainfall charts for six stops on the route to predict November conditions, answering at least 3 of 4 prediction questions correctly before the answer is revealed.
prerequisites: Mediterranean climate: hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters
November as the start of the wet season
Mean daily high and low temperature

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, then reveal (prediction questions with data feedback), followed by free exploration
keyQuestions: Which stops will be coolest in November, and why?
When does the Mediterranean get its rain?
Why is the hottest month later than the longest day?
commonMisconceptions: The Mediterranean is warm and sunny all year.
Istanbul has the same weather as Athens because both are 'Mediterranean.'
Winter rain means it rains every day.
Summer is the wet season, as in many northern climates.
assessmentOpportunities: Score on four locked-in predictions (mastery: 3 of 4).
Compare November rainfall at Rhodes and Heraklion from the exploration view.
